verdict.rationale: E2B has no documented account-level data export. You can still get sandbox data out yourself: `files.list()`/`files.read()` and `commands.run()` let you copy raw files, and the open-source, Terraform-deployable self-hosting option gives a credible way to leave the hosted service. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-wide data export, export of paused-sandbox state or snapshots in an open, portable format (snapshots are E2B templates), and independent corroboration of a full migration or exit.
